qAndA.answer: The magnet distorts the image on the screen due to its magnetic field affecting the electron beam inside the monitor.
qAndA.question: What happens to the screen of a tube-type monitor when a magnet is brought close to it?

qAndA.answer: Reversing the poles reverses the direction of the screen distortion.
qAndA.question: How does reversing the poles of the magnet affect the screen distortion?

qAndA.answer: It takes the shape of a cone.
qAndA.question: What shape does the 'warp' field take around a coiled wire carrying current?

qAndA.answer: Degaussing removes residual magnetism from the monitor, restoring the image to its normal state.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of degaussing a monitor?

qAndA.answer: The law states that the force between two parallel wires is proportional to the product of their currents and inversely proportional to the distance between them. When currents flow in the same direction, the resulting force is attractive.
qAndA.question: How does Ampere's Force Law explain the attraction of two wires carrying current in the same direction?

youtube_description:
Exceptions to Ampere's Force Law:
A beam of electrons does not produce a magnetic field. It doesn't have enough mass to apply any useful force, so it deflects. See http://www.physicsforums.com/showthread.php?t=13374 and
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TKSfAkWWN0

This video introduces the concept of "warp fields" to intuitively graph the physical forces of magnetism, but the actual mechanism of attraction is relativistic in nature. See: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TKSfAkWWN0

This guy explains something similar using the Lorentz force for antigravity technology.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LJ7qLSzWC2Y&list=WL

Here is a gentle reminder that what we are taught about electronics in textbooks and electrical circuit diagrams isn't quite right. They say it doesn't matter that Ben Franklin got it wrong and current in wires actually flows in the other direction, but it prevents us from understanding "warp technology" and how the vortex forms the letters N and S.

"More on" conventional current http://www.rare-earth-magnets.com/t-conventional-vs-electron-flow.aspx
